Arms and ammunition found in Poonch militant hideout

Security forces discovered a militant hideout in the Sawjian sector of Poonch, Jammu and Kashmir, recovering arms and ammunition. The recovered items include an AK-47 rifle and six hand grenades. An investigation into the matter is underway.
